brief: Clear the ventilation grilles obstructed by stacked pallets left inside the compound and top up the oil sight glass reading below the minimum mark at ambient. Because forced cooling is partially unavailable on this ONAN unit, reduce permissible load in proportion to the cooling capacity lost according to MG-021. Apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward as required by MG-021 for sustained events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees.
